Pubgrade v2.0 is out 🎉

It lives in your IDE's sidebar and lists the outdated packages of your Flutter project. You see the changelog of each new version and one click to upgrade.

No more missing updates, no more upgrading without knowing breaking changes.

Now also supports IntelliJ and Android Studio, besides VS Code and its forks (Cursor, Antigravity etc).

Search "Pubgrade" in your IDE's extensions panel.
